name: Cheating During Testing
desc:
😰 You forgot to study.  
Now cheating is your only option.

🚨 Every answer is a risk. Every second counts.

The clock is ticking…  
Finish your test before time runs out—but whatever you do…

Don’t let the teacher see you cheating.

📄 Complete tests and earn Credits.  
⭐ Higher grades earn even bigger rewards.  
🛒 Buy cheating gadgets, and equipment to improve your chances.  
👀 Beware of Snitches—they’ll sell you out for Credits.  
🍎 Manage your Anxiety throughout the exam.  
🤝 Team up with friends… if you can trust them.

🏆 Outsmart the classroom.  
💰 Build the ultimate loadout.  
📚 Become the ultimate cheater.

How long can you keep fooling the teacher?

⚠️ Disclaimer: Cheating during tests, rule-breaking, and avoiding teachers are fictional gameplay mechanics and are NOT meant to encourage or promote these behaviors in real life.
